use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::thread;
use std::time::Duration;

use tokio;
use tokio::net::UdpSocket;
use tokio::sync::mpsc;

// Define the message structure
enum Message {
    Append(Vec<u8>),
    Vote(Vec<u8>),
    VoteResult(bool),
}

// Define the leader's state
struct Leader {
    id: u64,
    term: u64,
    votes: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<u64, bool>>>,
    followers: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<u64, SocketAddr>>>,
    socket: UdpSocket,
}

impl Leader {
    async fn new(id: u64, term: u64) -> Self {
        let mut votes = Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));
        votes.lock().unwrap().insert(id, true);
        Leader {
            id,
            term,
            votes,
            followers: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),
            socket: UdpSocket::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap(),
        }
    }

    async fn start(&self) {
        loop {
            let mut buf = [0; 1024];
            let (amt, src) = self.socket.recv_from(&mut buf).unwrap();
            let msg = Message::from_slice(&buf[..amt]).unwrap();
            match msg {
                Message::Vote(vote) => {
                    let term = vote[0];
                    if term > self.term {
                        self.term = term;
                        self.votes.lock().unwrap().insert(term, true);
                    }
                }
                Message::Append(append) => {
                    // Append the log entry
                    // ...
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Define the follower's state
struct Follower {
    id: u64,
    term: u64,
    leader: Option<u64>,
    socket: UdpSocket,
}

impl Follower {
    async fn new(id: u64, term: u64) -> Self {
        Follower {
            id,
            term,
            leader: None,
            socket: UdpSocket::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap(),
        }
    }

    async fn start(&self) {
        loop {
            let mut buf = [0; 1024];
            let (amt, src) = self.socket.recv_from(&mut buf).unwrap();
            let msg = Message::from_slice(&buf[..amt]).unwrap();
            match msg {
                Message::VoteResult(result) => {
                    if result {
                        self.leader = Some(self.term);
                    }
                }
                Message::Append(append) => {
                    // Append the log entry
                    // ...
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

public enum State {
    START,
    RUNNING,
    STOPPED
}

public interface Guard {
    boolean evaluate();
}

public interface ActionHook {
    void execute();
}

public class Transition {
    private State from;
    private State to;
    private Guard guard;
    private ActionHook actionHook;

    public Transition(State from, State to, Guard guard, ActionHook actionHook) {
        this.from = from;
        this.to = to;
        this.guard = guard;
        this.actionHook = actionHook;
    }

    public State getFrom() {
        return from;
    }

    public State getTo() {
        return to;
    }

    public Guard getGuard() {
        return guard;
    }

    public ActionHook getActionHook() {
        return actionHook;
    }
}

public class StateMachine {
    private State state;
    private List<Transition> transitions;

    public StateMachine(State initialState) {
        this.state = initialState;
        this.transitions = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public void addTransition(Transition transition) {
        this.transitions.add(transition);
    }

    public void transition() {
        for (Transition transition : this.transitions) {
            if (transition.getFrom().equals(this.state) && transition.getGuard().evaluate()) {
                this.state = transition.getTo();
                transition.getActionHook().execute();
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    public State getState() {
        return this.state;
    }
}

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::thread;
use std::time::Duration;

// Process structure
struct Process {
    id: u32,
    priority: u32,
    aging: u32,
    period: u32,
}

impl Process {
    fn new(id: u32, priority: u32, period: u32) -> Self {
        Process {
            id,
            priority,
            aging: 0,
            period,
        }
    }
}

// Scheduler structure
struct Scheduler {
    processes: BTreeMap<u32, Process>,
}

impl Scheduler {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Scheduler {
            processes: BTreeMap::new(),
        }
    }

    fn add_process(&mut self, process: Process) {
        self.processes.insert(process.id, process);
    }

    fn schedule(&mut self) {
        // Sort processes by priority and aging
        let mut sorted_processes = self.processes.values_mut().collect::<Vec<_>>();
        sorted_processes.sort_by_key(|p| (p.priority, -p.aging));

        // Simulate scheduling
        for process in sorted_processes {
            println!("Scheduling process {}: {}", process.id, process.priority);
            thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(process.period as u64));
            process.aging += 1;
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new();

    // Create 75 processes with periodic tasks
    for i in 0..75 {
        let process = Process::new(i, i % 10 + 1, 100);
        scheduler.add_process(process);
    }

    scheduler.schedule();
}

import lexer
import syntax_highlighter

class PrattParser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.index = 0

    def parse(self):
        return self.parse_expression()

    def parse_expression(self):
        expr = self.parse_term()
        while self.peek_token().type == lexer.TokenType.PIPE:
            self.consume_token()
            expr = self.parse_term() + expr
        return expr

    def parse_term(self):
        term = self.parse_factor()
        while self.peek_token().type in (lexer.TokenType.PLUS, lexer.TokenType.MINUS):
            operator = self.consume_token()
            term = self.parse_factor() + operator + term
        return term

    def parse_factor(self):
        token = self.consume_token()
        if token.type == lexer.TokenType.NUMBER:
            return token.value
        elif token.type == lexer.TokenType.VARIABLE:
            return token.value
        elif token.type == lexer.TokenType.IMPORT:
            return self.parse_import()
        else:
            raise Exception(f"Unexpected token: {token}")

    def parse_import(self):
        token = self.consume_token()
        if token.type == lexer.TokenType.STRING:
            return f"import {token.value}"
        else:
            raise Exception(f"Unexpected token: {token}")

    def peek_token(self):
        return self.tokens[self.index] if self.index < len(self.tokens) else None

    def consume_token(self):
        token = self.peek_token()
        if token:
            self.index += 1
        return token

class PrattParserError(Exception):
    pass
"""

import re

class Token:
    def __init__(self, type, value):
        self.type = type
        self.value = value

class Lexer:
    def __init__(self, text):
        self.text = text
        self.index = 0

    def tokenize(self):
        tokens = []
        while self.index < len(self.text):
            match = re.match(r"\d+", self.text[self.index:])
            if match:
                token = Token(TokenType.NUMBER, int(match.group()))
                tokens.append(token)
                self.index += len(match.group())
            elif re.match(r"[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z_0-9]*", self.text[self.index:]):
                token = Token(TokenType.VARIABLE, self.text[self.index:].split()[0])
                tokens.append(token)
                self.index += len(token.value)
            elif re.match(r"import\s+([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z_0-9]*)", self.text[self.index:]):
                token = Token(TokenType.IMPORT, self.text[self.text.index(self.index):self.text.index(self.index) + len(token.value.split()[1])])
                tokens.append(token)
                self.index += len(token.value)
            elif re.match(r"[|]", self.text[self.index:]):
                token = Token(TokenType.PIPE, "|")
                tokens.append(token)
                self.index += 1
            elif re.match(r"[+\-]", self.text[self.index:]):
                token = Token(TokenType.PLUS, "+")
                tokens.append(token)
                self.index += 1
            elif re.match(r"[=]", self.text[self.index:]):
                token = Token(TokenType.EQUAL, "=")
                tokens.append(token)
                self.index += 1
            elif re.match(r"[;]", self.text[self.index:]):
                token = Token(TokenType.SEMICOLON, ";")
                tokens.append(token)
                self.index += 1
            elif re.match(r"\"[^\"]*\"", self.text[self.index:]):

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.Lock;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;

public class RateLimiter {
    private final int maxRequests;
    private final long windowSize;
    private final Lock lock;
    private final Map<String, RequestHistory> clientHistory;

    public RateLimiter(int maxRequests, long windowSize) {
        this.maxRequests = maxRequests;
        this.windowSize = windowSize;
        this.lock = new ReentrantLock();
        this.clientHistory = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    }

    public boolean isAllowed(String client, long timestamp) {
        lock.lock();
        try {
            RequestHistory history = clientHistory.computeIfAbsent(client, k -> new RequestHistory());
            if (history.addRequest(timestamp)) {
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        } finally {
            lock.unlock();
        }
    }

    private class RequestHistory {
        private final long[] timestamps;
        private int index;

        public RequestHistory() {
            this.timestamps = new long[(int) (windowSize / 1000)];
            this.index = 0;
        }

        public boolean addRequest(long timestamp) {
            timestamps[index++] = timestamp;
            if (index >= timestamps.length) {
                index = 0;
            }
            return index < timestamps.length;
        }
    }
  }
  """

use async_stream::stream;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Instant;

// Define a custom record type
#[derive(Debug)]
struct Record {
    value: i32,
    timestamp: Instant,
}

// Define a custom windowed aggregator
struct WindowedAggregator {
    window_size: u64,
    aggregation: Arc<dyn FnMut(Vec<i32>) -> i32 + Send + Sync>,
}

impl WindowedAggregator {
    fn new(window_size: u64, aggregation: Arc<dyn FnMut(Vec<i32>) -> i32 + Send + Sync>) -> Self {
        WindowedAggregator {
            window_size,
            aggregation,
        }
    }
}

impl stream::Stream for WindowedAggregator {
    type Item = (Vec<i32>, Instant);

    fn poll_next(self: Arc<Self>, cx: &mut std::task::Context) -> std::task::Poll<Option<Self::Item>> {
        // Simulate a stream of records
        let records: Vec<(Record, Instant)> = (0..10)
            .map(|i| (Record { value: i as i32, timestamp: Instant::now() }, Instant::now()))
            .collect();

        // Process the records in a window
        let mut window = Vec::new();
        let mut watermarks = HashMap::new();
        for (record, timestamp) in records {
            window.push(record.value);
            *watermarks.entry(timestamp).or_insert(0) += 1;

            // Check if the window is full
            if window.len() >= self.window_size as usize {
                // Aggregate the window
                let aggregated = (self.aggregation)(window.clone());

                // Check if there are any late records
                let mut late_records = Vec::new();
                for (timestamp, count) in watermarks.iter() {
                    if count > &1 {
                        late_records.push((timestamp, *count - 1));
                    }
                }

                // Return the aggregated window and late records
                return std::task::Poll::Ready(Some((window, *watermarks.iter().next().unwrap().1)));
            }
        }

        // Return None if the window is not full
        std::task::Poll::Ready(None)
    }
}

// Define a custom watermark handler
enum WatermarkHandler {
    Ignore,
    Drop,
}

impl WatermarkHandler {
    fn handle(&self, watermark: Instant) {
        match self {
            WatermarkHandler::Ignore => (),
            WatermarkHandler::Drop => (),
        }
    }
}

// Define a custom pipeline
struct Pipeline {
    aggregator: WindowedAggregator,
    watermark_handler: WatermarkHandler,
}

impl Pipeline {
    fn new(window_size: u64, aggregation: Arc<dyn FnMut(Vec<i32>) -> i32 + Send + Sync>) -> Self {
        Pipeline {
            aggregator: WindowedAggregator::new(window_size, aggregation),
            watermark_handler: WatermarkHandler::Ignore,
        }
    }
}

impl stream::Stream for Pipeline {
    type Item = (Vec<i32>, Instant);

    fn poll_next(self: Arc<Self>, cx: &mut std::task::Context) -> std::task::Poll<Option<Self::Item>> {
        // Delegating to the aggregator
        self.aggregator.poll_next(cx)
    }
}

}

import abc
from typing import Dict, Set

class CRDT(abc.ABC):
    @abc.abstractmethod
    def add(self, value: str):
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    def remove(self, value: str):
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    def merge(self, other: 'CRDT'):
        pass

class GCounter(CRDT):
    def __init__(self):
        self.counts: Dict[str, int] = {}

    def add(self, value: str):
        self.counts[value] = self.counts.get(value, 0) + 1

    def remove(self, value: str):
        self.counts[value] = max(0, self.counts.get(value, 0) - 1)

    def merge(self, other: 'GCounter'):
        for value, count in other.counts.items():
            self.counts[value] = self.counts.get(value, 0) + count

class PNCounter(CRDT):
    def __init__(self):
        self.counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def add(self, value: str):
        with self.lock:
            self.counts[value] = self.counts.get(value, 0) + 1

    def remove(self, value: str):
        with self.lock:
            self.counts[value] = max(0, self.counts.get(value, 0) - 1)

    def merge(self, other: 'PNCounter'):
        with self.lock:
            for value, count in other.counts.items():
                self.counts[value] = self.counts.get(value, 0) + count

class GSet(CRDT):
    def __init__(self):
        self.values: Set[str] = set()

    def add(self, value: str):
        self.values.add(value)

    def remove(self, value: str):
        self.values.discard(value)

    def merge(self, other: 'GSet'):
        self.values.update(other.values)

class ORSet(CRDT):
    def __init__(self):
        self.values: Set[str] = set()

    def add(self, value: str):
        self.values.add(value)

    def remove(self, value: str):
        self.values.discard(value)

    def merge(self, other: 'ORSet'):
        self.values.update(other.values)

class LWWRegister(CRDT):
    def __init__(self):
        self.values: Dict[str, float] = {}

    def add(self, value: str, timestamp: float):
        self.values[value] = max(self.values.get(value, 0), timestamp)

    def remove(self, value: str, timestamp: float):
        if value in self.values and self.values[value] <= timestamp:
            del self.values[value]

    def merge(self, other: 'LWWRegister'):
        for value, timestamp in other.values.items():
            self.add(value, timestamp)

class LWWMap(CRDT):
    def __init__(self):
        self.values: Dict[str, Dict[str, float]] = {}

    def add(self, key: str, value: str, timestamp: float):
        if key not in self.values:
            self.values[key] = {}
        self.values[key][value] = max(self.values[key].get(value, 0), timestamp)

    def remove(self, key: str, value: str, timestamp: float):
        if key in self.values and value in self.values[key] and self.values[key][value] <= timestamp:
            del self.values[key][value]

    def merge(self, other: 'LWWMap'):
        for key, values in other.values.items():
            if key not in self.values:
                self.values[key] = {}
            for value, timestamp in values.items():
                self.add(key, value, timestamp)

import random
import time

class RetryStrategy:
    def __init__(self, max_attempts: int, initial_backoff: int):
        self.max_attempts = max_attempts
        self.initial_backoff = initial_backoff
        self.current_attempt = 0
        self.backoff = initial_backoff

    def should_retry(self):
        if self.current_attempt >= self.max_attempts:
            return False
        self.current_attempt += 1
        self.backoff = min(self.backoff * 2, 60)
        return True

    def get_backoff(self):

import socket
import mimetypes
import threading

class HTTPServer:
    def __init__(self, host='localhost', port=8000):
        self.host = host
        self.port = port
        self.server_socket = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        self.server_socket.bind((self.host, self.port))
        self.server_socket.listen(5)
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def handle_request(self, connection_socket):
        request = b''
        while True:
            chunk = connection_socket.recv(1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            request += chunk
            if b'\r\n\r\n' in request:
                break

        request_lines = request.decode().splitlines()
        method, path, http_version = request_lines[0].split()
        headers = {}
        for line in request_lines[1:]:
            if line:
                key, value = line.split(':', 1)
                headers[key] = value.strip()

        with self.lock:
            if method == 'GET':
                if path == '/':
                    with open('index.html', 'rb') as f:
                        response = b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n' + f.read()
                elif path.endswith('/'):
                    with open('index.html', 'rb') as f:
                        response = b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n' + f.read()
                else:
                    try:
                        with open(path[1:], 'rb') as f:
                            response = b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n' + f.read()
                    except FileNotFoundError:
                        response = b'HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\n'
                mime_type, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(path)
                if mime_type:
                    response = b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: ' + mime_type.encode() + b'\r\n\r\n' + response
            elif method == 'POST':
                response = b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n'

        connection_socket.sendall(response)
        connection_socket.close()

    def start(self):
        print(f'Server listening on {self.host}:{self.port}')
        while True:
            connection_socket, address = self.server_socket.accept()
            thread = threading.Thread(target=self.handle_request, args=(connection_socket,))
            thread.start()

    def shutdown(self):
        self.server_socket.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    server = HTTPServer()
    server.start()
    try:
        while True:
            pass
    except KeyboardInterrupt:

#include <iostream>
#include <chrono>
#include <random>
#include <vector>

// Function to get the maximum element to determine the number of digits
int getMax(int arr[], int n) {
  int max = arr[0];
  for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
    if (arr[i] > max)
      max = arr[i];
  }
  return max;
}

// Function to perform counting sort for the given digit
void countingSort(int arr[], int n, int exp) {
  int output[n];
  int count[10] = {0};

  // Store count of occurrences in count[]
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    int index = (arr[i] / exp);
    count[index % 10]++;
  }

  // Change count[i] so that count[i] now contains the actual
  //  position of this digit in output[] array
  for (int i = 1; i < 10; i++)
    count[i] += count[i - 1];

  // Build the output array
  for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    int index = (arr[i] / exp);
    output[count[index % 10] - 1] = arr[i];
    count[index % 10]--;
  }

  // Copy the sorted elements into original array
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
    arr[i] = output[i];
}

// Function to perform radix sort
void radixSort(int arr[], int n) {
  int max = getMax(arr, n);

  // Perform counting sort for every digit. Note that instead
  // of passing digit number, exp is passed. The idea is to
  // use exp = exp*10 in every next digit
  for (int exp = 1; max / exp > 0; exp *= 10)
    countingSort(arr, n, exp);
}

// Function to print the array
void printArray(int arr[], int n) {
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
    std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
  std::cout << std::endl;
}

int main() {
  int n = 1000000;
  std::random_device rd;
  std::mt19937 gen(rd());
  std::uniform_int_distribution<> dis(1, 1000000);
  int arr[n];

  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
    arr[i] = dis(gen);

  auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  radixSort(arr, n);
  auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::seconds>(end - start);
  std::cout << "Radix sort time: " << duration.count() << " seconds" << std::endl;

  start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  std::sort(arr, arr + n);
  end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::seconds>(end - start);
  std::cout << "Standard library sort time: " << duration.count() << " seconds" << std::endl;

  return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

const int N = 479201;
const int M = 352698;

struct SegmentTree {
    vector<int> tree;
    int size;

    SegmentTree(int n) : size(n) {
        tree.resize(4 * n);
    }

    int query(int l, int r) {
        return query(0, size - 1, l, r, 0);
    }

    int query(int node, int start, int end, int l, int r) {
        if (l > end || r < start) return INT_MAX;
        if (l <= start && end <= r) return tree[node];
        int mid = (start + end) / 2;
        int left = query(2 * node + 1, start, mid, l, r);
        int right = query(2 * node + 2, mid + 1, end, l, r);
        return min(left, right);
    }

    void update(int i, int val) {
        update(0, size - 1, i, val, 0);
    }

    void update(int node, int start, int end, int i, int val) {
        if (i < start || i > end) return;
        if (start == end) {
            tree[node] = val;
            return;
        }
        int mid = (start + end) / 2;
        update(2 * node + 1, start, mid, i, val);
        update(2 * node + 2, mid + 1, end, i, val);
        tree[node] = min(tree[2 * node + 1], tree[2 * node + 2]);
    }
};

struct SparseTable {
    vector<vector<int>> table;
    int n;

    SparseTable(int n) : n(n) {
        table.resize(n, vector<int>(20));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            table[i][0] = i;
        }
        for (int j = 1; (1 << j) <= n; j++) {
            for (int i = 0; i + (1 << j) - 1 < n; i++) {
                table[i][j] = __gcd(table[i][j - 1], table[i + (1 << (j - 1))][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }

    int query(int l, int r) {
        int j = log2(r - l + 1);
        return __gcd(table[l][j], table[r - (1 << j) + 1][j]);
    }
};

int main() {
    int n = N;
    int m = M;
    SegmentTree st(n);
    SparseTable sp(n);

    // Generate random data
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        st.update(i, rand() % 100);
    }

    // Test range minimum queries
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int l, r;
        cin >> l >> r;
        l--; r--;
        int min_val = st.query(l, r);
        cout << "Minimum value in range [" << l << ", " << r << "]: " << min_val << endl;

        int gcd_val = sp.query(l, r);
        cout << "GCD value in range [" << l << ", " << r << "]: " << gcd_val << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

import * as net from 'net';
import * as tls from 'tls';
import { v5 as uuidv5 } from 'uuid';

interface MqttConnection {
  socket: net.Socket | tls.TLSSocket;
  clientId: string;
  will?: {
    topic: string;
    payload: Buffer;
    qos: number;
  };
}

class MqttBroker {
  private connections: Map<string, MqttConnection> = new Map();
  private messageQueue: PriorityQueue = new PriorityQueue();

  constructor() {
    this.messageQueue = new PriorityQueue((a, b) => a.priority - b.priority);
  }

  handleConnection(socket: net.Socket | tls.TLSSocket) {
    const clientId = uuidv5(socket.remoteAddress, socket.remotePort);
    this.connections.set(clientId, {
      socket,
      clientId,
    });

    socket.on('data', (data) => {
      const packet = MqttPacket.decode(data);
      if (packet.type === 'CONNECT') {
        this.handleConnect(packet);
      } else if (packet.type === 'PUBLISH') {
        this.handlePublish(packet);
      }
    });

    socket.on('close', () => {
      this.connections.delete(clientId);
    });
  }

  private handleConnect(packet: MqttPacket) {
    const clientId = packet.properties.clientId;
    const will = packet.properties.will;
    const qos = packet.properties.qos;

    this.connections.get(clientId).will = will;
    this.connections.get(clientId).qos = qos;
  }

  private handlePublish(packet: MqttPacket) {
    const topic = packet.topic;
    const qos = packet.properties.qos;
    const payload = packet.payload;

    this.messageQueue.enqueue({
      topic,
      qos,
      payload,
      priority: qos,
    });

    this.connections.forEach((connection) => {
      if (connection.will && connection.will.topic === topic) {
        this.sendMessage(connection.socket, packet);
      }
    });
  }

  private sendMessage(socket: net.Socket | tls.TLSSocket, packet: MqttPacket) {
    const will = this.connections.get(packet.properties.clientId).will;
    if (will) {
      const willPacket = MqttPacket.encode({
        type: 'PUBLISH',
        topic: will.topic,
        payload: will.payload,
        qos: will.qos,
      });
      socket.write(willPacket);
    }
  }
}

class PriorityQueue<T> {
  private heap: T[] = [];

  constructor(comparator: (a: T, b: T) => number) {
    this.comparator = comparator;
  }

  private comparator: (a: T, b: T) => number;

  enqueue(item: T) {
    this.heap.push(item);
    this.heapifyUp(this.heap.length - 1);
  }

  dequeue(): T | undefined {
    if (this.heap.length === 0) return undefined;

    const item = this.heap[0];
    this.heap[0] = this.heap[this.heap.length - 1];
    this.heap.pop();
    this.heapifyDown(0);
    return item;
  }

  private heapifyUp(index: number) {
    while (index > 0) {
      const parentIndex = Math.floor((index - 1) / 2);
      if (this.comparator(this.heap[parentIndex], this.heap[index]) <= 0) break;
      [this.heap[parentIndex], this.heap[index]] = [this.heap[index], this.heap[parentIndex]];
      index = parentIndex;
    }
  }

  private heapifyDown(index: number) {
    while (true) {
      const leftChildIndex = 2 * index + 1;
      const rightChildIndex = 2 * index + 2;
      let smallest = index;

      if (leftChildIndex < this.heap.length && this.comparator(this.heap[leftChildIndex], this.heap[smallest]) < 0) {
        smallest = leftChildIndex;
      }

      if (rightChildIndex < this.heap.length && this.comparator(this.heap[rightChildIndex], this.heap[smallest]) < 0) {
        smallest = rightChildIndex;
      }

      if (smallest === index) break;
      [this.heap[index], this.heap[smallest]] = [this.heap[smallest], this.heap[index]];
      index = smallest;
    }
  }
}

class MqttPacket {
  static encode(packet: MqttPacket) {
    const header = Buffer.alloc(2);
    header.writeUInt8(packet.type, 0);
    header.writeUInt8(packet.properties.qos, 1);

    const payload = Buffer.alloc(packet.payload.length);
    packet.payload.copy(payload);

    const packetBuffer = Buffer.alloc(header.length + payload.length);
    header.copy(packetBuffer, 0);
    payload.copy(packetBuffer, header.length);

    return packetBuffer;
  }

  static decode(buffer: Buffer) {
    const header = buffer.slice(0, 2);
    const type = header.readUInt8(0);
    const qos = header.readUInt8(1);

    const payload = buffer.slice(2);
    return {
      type,
      topic: '',
      properties: {
        qos,
        will: undefined,
        clientId: '',
      },
      payload,
    };
  }
}

class MqttServer {
  private server: net.Server;

  constructor() {
    this.server = net.createServer((socket) => {
      this.handleConnection(socket);
    });
  }

  listen(port: number) {
    this.server.listen(port, () => {
      console.log(`MQTT broker listening on port ${port}`);
    });
  }

  private handleConnection(socket: net.Socket) {
    const mqttBroker = new MqttBroker();
    mqttBroker.handleConnection(socket);
  }
}

const mqttServer = new MqttServer();
mqttServer.listen(1883);

import numpy as np
from heapq import heappop, heappush

class Grid:
    def __init__(self, width: int, height: int):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.grid = np.zeros((height, width), dtype=int)

    def set_obstacle(self, x: int, y: int):
        self.grid[y, x] = 1

    def heuristic(self, x1: int, y1: int, x2: int, y2: int):
        return abs(x1 - x2) + abs(y1 - y2)

    def astar(self, start: tuple, goal: tuple):
        open_set = []
        heappush(open_set, (0, start))
        came_from = {}
        cost_so_far = {start: 0}

        while open_set:
            _, current = heappop(open_set)
            if current == goal:
                break

            for dx, dy in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]:
                x, y = current[0] + dx, current[1] + dy
                if 0 <= x < self.width and 0 <= y < self.height and self.grid[y, x] == 0:
                    new_cost = cost_so_far[current] + 1
                    if (x, y) not in cost_so_far or new_cost < cost_so_far[(x, y)]:
                        cost_so_far[(x, y)] = new_cost
                        priority = new_cost + self.heuristic(x, y, goal[0], goal[1])
                        heappush(open_set, (priority, (x, y)))
                        came_from[(x, y)] = current

        # Reconstruct the path
        current = goal
        path = []
        while current != start:
            path.append(current)
            current = came_from[current]
        path.append(start)
        path.reverse()
        return path
    """

import threading

class Reader:
    def __init__(self, lock):
        self.lock = lock
        self.readers = 0

    def acquire(self):
        self.lock.acquire()
        self.readers += 1
        if self.readers == 1:
            self.lock.wait_for(self.writers_empty, 1)
        self.lock.release()

    def release(self):
        self.lock.acquire()
        self.readers -= 1
        if self.readers == 0:
            self.lock.notify_all()
        self.lock.release()

    def writers_empty(self):
        return self.lock.locked() and self.readers == 0

class Writer:
    def __init__(self, lock):
        self.lock = lock

    def acquire(self):
        self.lock.acquire()
        self.lock.wait_for(self.readers_empty, 1)
        self.lock.release()

    def release(self):
        self.lock.acquire()
        self.lock.release()

    def readers_empty(self):
        return not self.lock.locked()

class ReadWriteLock:
    def __init__(self):
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.reader = Reader(self.lock)
        self.writer = Writer(self.lock)

    def acquire_read(self):
        self.reader.acquire()

    def release_read(self):
        self.reader.release()

    def acquire_write(self):
        self.writer.acquire()

    def release_write(self):
        self.writer.release()

        writers = []
        readers = []

            lock.acquire_write()
            lock.release_write()

        def reader():
            lock.acquire_read()
            lock.release_read()

        for _ in range(50):
            readers.append(threading.Thread(target=reader))
            readers[-1].start()

        writers.append(threading.Thread(target=writer))
        writers[-1].start()

        for reader in readers:

package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"math"
	"sync"
)

// StreamPriority represents the priority of a stream
type StreamPriority int

const (
	// StreamPriorityLow represents the lowest priority
	StreamPriorityLow StreamPriority = iota
	// StreamPriorityMedium represents the medium priority
	StreamPriorityMedium
	// StreamPriorityHigh represents the highest priority
	StreamPriorityHigh
)

// FrameHeader represents the HTTP/2 frame header
type FrameHeader struct {
	Length uint32
	Type   uint8
}

// Frame represents an HTTP/2 frame
type Frame struct {
	Header FrameHeader
	Payload []byte
}

// Stream represents an HTTP/2 stream
type Stream struct {
	ID uint32
	Priority StreamPriority
}

// PriorityQueue represents a priority queue
type PriorityQueue struct {
	*sync.BoundedWaitGroup
	*sync.Mutex
	// head of the priority queue
	Head *Stream
	// tail of the priority queue
	Tail *Stream
}

func (pq *PriorityQueue) Push(stream *Stream) {
	pq.Lock()
	defer pq.Unlock()
	pq.Add(1)
	pq.Head = stream
	pq.Tail = stream
}

func (pq *PriorityQueue) Pop() *Stream {
	pq.Lock()
	defer pq.Unlock()
	pq.Done(1)
	stream := pq.Head
	pq.Head = nil
	pq.Tail = nil
	return stream
}

func (pq *PriorityQueue) Prioritize(stream *Stream) {
	pq.Lock()
	defer pq.Unlock()
	if stream.Priority == StreamPriorityLow {
		pq.BoundedWaitGroup.Add(1)
		pq.Head = stream
	} else if stream.Priority == StreamPriorityMedium {
		pq.BoundedWaitGroup.Add(1)
		pq.Tail = stream
	} else if stream.Priority == StreamPriorityHigh {
		pq.BoundedWaitGroup.Add(1)
		pq.Head = stream
		pq.Tail = stream
	}
}

func parseFrameHeader(reader io.Reader) (*FrameHeader, error) {
	var header FrameHeader
	if err := binary.Read(reader, binary.BigEndian, &header.Length); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := binary.Read(reader, binary.BigEndian, &header.Type); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &header, nil
}

func parseFramePayload(reader io.Reader, header *FrameHeader) ([]byte, error) {
	payload := make([]byte, header.Length)
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(reader, payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return payload, nil
}

func parseStreamPriority(reader io.Reader) (StreamPriority, error) {
	var priority uint8
	if err := binary.Read(reader, binary.BigEndian, &priority); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	switch priority {
	case 0:
		return StreamPriorityLow, nil
	case 1:
		return StreamPriorityMedium, nil
	case 2:
		return StreamPriorityHigh, nil
	default:
		return 0, errors.New("invalid stream priority")
	}
}

func parseStreamID(reader io.Reader) (uint32, error) {
	var id uint32
	if err := binary.Read(reader, binary.BigEndian, &id); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return id, nil
}

func parseStream(reader io.Reader) (*Stream, error) {
	id, err := parseStreamID(reader)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	priority, err := parseStreamPriority(reader)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &Stream{ID: id, Priority: priority}, nil
}

func parseFrame(reader io.Reader) (*Frame, error) {
	header, err := parseFrameHeader(reader)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	payload, err := parseFramePayload(reader, header)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &Frame{Header: *header, Payload: payload}, nil
}

func parseStreamFrame(reader io.Reader) (*Stream, *Frame, error) {
	stream, err := parseStream(reader)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	frame, err := parseFrame(reader)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	return stream, frame, nil
}

func parseStreamFrames(reader io.Reader, pq *PriorityQueue) error {
	for {
		stream, frame, err := parseStreamFrame(reader)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		pq.Prioritize(stream)
		if frame.Header.Type == 0 {
			break
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func parseConnectionMultiplexing(reader io.Reader, pq *PriorityQueue) error {
	for {
		if err := parseStreamFrames(reader, pq); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func parseHTTP2Frame(reader io.Reader) error {
	pq := &PriorityQueue{&sync.BoundedWaitGroup{}, &sync.Mutex{}, nil, nil}
	if err := parseConnectionMultiplexing(reader, pq); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	// Create a sample HTTP/2 frame reader
	reader := bytes.NewReader([]byte{
		0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, // Length
		0x01, // Type
		0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, // Stream ID
		0x00, // Stream Priority
		0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, // Frame Header
		0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, // Frame Payload
	})

	// Parse the HTTP/2 frame
	if err := parseHTTP2Frame(reader); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Callable, Dict, List, Optional

class State(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def enter(self) -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def exit(self) -> None:
        pass

class Transition:
    def __init__(self, from_state: 'State', to_state: 'State', guard: Optional[Callable[[State], bool]] = None, action: Optional[Callable[[State], None]] = None):
        self.from_state = from_state
        self.to_state = to_state
        self.guard = guard
        self.action = action

class StateMachine:
    def __init__(self, initial_state: State):
        self.states = {}
        self.transitions = []
        self.current_state = initial_state
        self.states[initial_state.__class__.__name__] = initial_state

    def add_state(self, state: State) -> None:
        self.states[state.__class__.__name__] = state

    def add_transition(self, transition: Transition) -> None:
        self.transitions.append(transition)

    def transition(self, transition: Transition) -> None:
        if transition.guard is not None and not transition.guard(self.current_state):
            return
        self.current_state.exit()
        self.current_state = transition.to_state
        self.current_state.enter()
        if transition.action is not None:
            transition.action(self.current_state)
    """

import threading
import time
import queue
import logging
from typing import Optional
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from logging.handlers import TimedRotatingFileHandler

class ConnectionPool:
    def __init__(
        self,
        min_size: int,
        max_size: int,
        idle_timeout: float,
        health_check_interval: float,
        health_check_timeout: float,
        connection_class,
        *args,
        **kwargs,
    ):
        self.min_size = min_size
        self.max_size = max_size
        self.idle_timeout = idle_timeout
        self.health_check_interval = health_check_interval
        self.health_check_timeout = health_check_timeout
        self.connection_class = connection_class
        self.args = args
        self.kwargs = kwargs
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.connections = []
        self.health_check_queue = queue.Queue()
        self.shutdown_event = threading.Event()

    def _create_connection(self):
        with self.lock:
            return self.connection_class(*self.args, **self.kwargs)

    def _get_connection(self):
        with self.lock:
            if self.connections:
                return self.connections.pop(0)
            else:
                return self._create_connection()

    def _release_connection(self, connection):
        with self.lock:
            self.connections.append(connection)

    def _health_check(self):
        with self.lock:
            self.health_check_queue.put(None)

    def _drain_connections(self):
        with self.lock:
            while self.connections:
                connection = self.connections.pop(0)
                try:
                    connection.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass

    def _shutdown(self):
        with self.lock:
            self.shutdown_event.set()
            self._drain_connections()

    def _check_idle_timeout(self):
        with self.lock:
            now = time.time()
            self.connections = [conn for conn in self.connections if now - conn.last_used < self.idle_timeout]

    def _check_health(self):
        with self.lock:
            while not self.health_check_queue.empty():
                try:
                    self.health_check_queue.get(block=False)
                except queue.Empty:
                    pass
                else:
                    continue
                self.health_check_queue.put(None)
                connection = self._get_connection()
                try:
                    connection.ping()
                except Exception:
                    connection.close()
                    self._release_connection(connection)
                finally:
                    self._release_connection(connection)

    def get_connection(self):
        with self.lock:
            self._check_idle_timeout()
            self._check_health()
            if len(self.connections) < self.min_size:
                self._create_connection()
            if len(self.connections) > self.max_size:
                self._release_connection(self.connections.pop(-1))
            return self.connections[0]

    def release_connection(self, connection):
        with self.lock:
            self._release_connection(connection)

    def shutdown(self):
        with self.lock:
            self._shutdown()

    def get_connection(self):

class FreeBlock:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.size = size
        self.prev = None
        self.next = None

    def __init__(self, initial_size):
        self.heap = []
        self.free_list = None
        self.total_size = initial_size

        for i in range(0, initial_size, 16):
            block = FreeBlock(16)
            block.prev = block.next = None
            if not self.free_list:
                self.free_list = block
            else:
                self.free_list.next = block
                block.prev = self.free_list
                self.free_list = block
            heapq.heappush(self.heap, (block.size, i))

    def allocate(self, size):
        if not self.free_list:
            raise MemoryError("Out of memory")

        while self.heap and self.heap[0][0] < size:
            _, i = heapq.heappop(self.heap)

                block = block.next

import java.util.*;

public class ConsistentHashRing {
    private final int VIRTUAL_NODES = 100;
    private final Map<String, Integer> nodes = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<Integer, String> ring = new TreeMap<>();

    public void addNode(String node) {
        int hash = hash(node);
        for (int i = 0; i < VIRTUAL_NODES; i++) {
            int virtualHash = (hash + i) % 2_147_483_647;
            nodes.put(node + "_" + i, virtualHash);
        }
        updateRing();
    }

    public void removeNode(String node) {
        nodes.remove(node);
        updateRing();
    }

    public String getNode(String key) {
        int hash = hash(key);
        String result = null;
        for (Map.Entry<Integer, String> entry : ring.entrySet()) {
            if (hash < entry.getKey()) {
                result = entry.getValue();
                break;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    private int hash(String key) {
        return Math.abs(key.hashCode() % 2_147_483_647);
    }

    private void updateRing() {
        ring.clear();
        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : nodes.entrySet()) {
            ring.put(entry.getValue(), entry.getKey());
        }
    }
  }

import threading

class Node:
    def __init__(self, key: str, value: str):
        self.key = key
        self.value = value
        self.prev = None
        self.next = None

class LRUCache:
    def __init__(self, max_capacity: int):
        self.max_capacity = max_capacity
        self.cache = {}
        self.head = Node("HEAD", None)
        self.tail = Node("TAIL", None)
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def get(self, key: str) -> str:
        with self.lock:
            if key in self.cache:
                node = self.cache[key]
                self._move_to_head(node)
                return node.value
            return None

    def put(self, key: str, value: str) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            if key in self.cache:
                node = self.cache[key]
                node.value = value
                self._move_to_head(node)
            else:
                if len(self.cache) >= self.max_capacity:
                    self._remove_lru()
                new_node = Node(key, value)
                self._add_to_head(new_node)
                self.cache[key] = new_node

    def _move_to_head(self, node: Node) -> None:
        self._remove_node(node)
        self._add_to_head(node)

    def _remove_node(self, node: Node) -> None:
        node.prev.next = node.next
        if node.next:
            node.next.prev = node.prev

    def _add_to_head(self, node: Node) -> None:
        node.prev = self.head
        node.next = self.head.next
        self.head.next.prev = node
        self.head.next = node

    def _remove_lru(self) -> None:
        lru_node = self.tail.prev
        self._remove_node(lru_node)
        del self.cache[lru_node.key]
    """

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#define MAX_PROCESSES 55
#define MAX_NAME_LENGTH 10

typedef struct Process {
    int pid;
    int priority;
    int deadline;
    int remaining_time;
    char name[MAX_NAME_LENGTH];
} Process;

typedef struct HeapNode {
    Process process;
    int index;
} HeapNode;

typedef struct Heap {
    HeapNode nodes[MAX_PROCESSES];
    int size;
} Heap;

void swap(HeapNode* a, HeapNode* b) {
    HeapNode temp = *a;
    *a = *b;
    *b = temp;
}

void heapify_up(Heap* heap, int index) {
    if (index == 0) return;
    int parent_index = (index - 1) / 2;
    if (heap->nodes[parent_index].process.priority > heap->nodes[index].process.priority) {
        swap(&heap->nodes[parent_index], &heap->nodes[index]);
        heapify_up(heap, parent_index);
    }
}

void heapify_down(Heap* heap, int index) {
    int left_child_index = 2 * index + 1;
    int right_child_index = 2 * index + 2;
    int smallest = index;
    if (left_child_index < heap->size && heap->nodes[left_child_index].process.priority < heap->nodes[smallest].process.priority) {
        smallest = left_child_index;
    }
    if (right_child_index < heap->size && heap->nodes[right_child_index].process.priority < heap->nodes[smallest].process.priority) {
        smallest = right_child_index;
    }
    if (smallest != index) {
        swap(&heap->nodes[index], &heap->nodes[smallest]);
        heapify_down(heap, smallest);
    }
}

void insert_process(Heap* heap, Process process) {
    heap->nodes[heap->size].process = process;
    heap->nodes[heap->size].index = heap->size;
    heapify_up(heap, heap->size);
    heap->size++;
}

void remove_process(Heap* heap, int index) {
    if (index == heap->size - 1) {
        heap->size--;
        return;
    }
    heap->nodes[index].process = heap->nodes[heap->size - 1].process;
    heap->nodes[index].index = index;
    heapify_down(heap, index);
    heap->size--;
}

void schedule_process(Heap* heap, int current_time) {
    if (heap->size == 0) return;
    Process current_process = heap->nodes[0].process;
    if (current_process.remaining_time > 0 && current_process.deadline >= current_time) {
        current_process.remaining_time--;
        heapify_up(heap, 0);
    } else {
        remove_process(heap, 0);
    }
}

int main() {
    srand(time(NULL));
    Heap heap;
    heap.size = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_PROCESSES; i++) {
        Process process;
        process.pid = i;
        process.priority = rand() % 10 + 1;
        process.deadline = rand() % 10 + 1;
        process.remaining_time = rand() % 5 + 1;
        strcpy(process.name, "Process ");
        char number[10];
        sprintf(number, "%d", i);
        strcat(process.name, number);
        insert_process(&heap, process);
    }
    int current_time = 0;
    while (heap.size > 0) {
        schedule_process(&heap, current_time);
        current_time++;
    }
    return 0;
}

package main

import (
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
)

type ConcurrentHashMap struct {
	buckets []*bucket
}

type bucket struct {
	lock   sync.RWMutex
	values map[string]interface{}
}

func NewConcurrentHashMap(size int) *ConcurrentHashMap {
	buckets := make([]*bucket, size)
	for i := range buckets {
		buckets[i] = &bucket{
			values: make(map[string]interface{}),
		}
	}
	return &ConcurrentHashMap{buckets: buckets}
}

func (m *ConcurrentHashMap) Get(key string) (interface{}, bool) {
	bucketIndex := hash(key) % len(m.buckets)
	m.buckets[bucketIndex].lock.RLock()
	defer m.buckets[bucketIndex].lock.RUnlock()
	value, ok := m.buckets[bucketIndex].values[key]
	return value, ok
}

func (m *ConcurrentHashMap) Put(key string, value interface{}) {
	bucketIndex := hash(key) % len(m.buckets)
	m.buckets[bucketIndex].lock.Lock()
	defer m.buckets[bucketIndex].lock.Unlock()
	m.buckets[bucketIndex].values[key] = value
}

func (m *ConcurrentHashMap) ComputeIfAbsent(key string, f func() interface{}) interface{} {
	bucketIndex := hash(key) % len(m.buckets)
	m.buckets[bucketIndex].lock.Lock()
	defer m.buckets[bucketIndex].lock.Unlock()
	if value, ok := m.buckets[bucketIndex].values[key]; ok {
		return value
	}
	return f()
}

func (m *ConcurrentHashMap) ReplaceIfEqual(key string, oldValue interface{}, newValue interface{}) bool {
	bucketIndex := hash(key) % len(m.buckets)
	m.buckets[bucketIndex].lock.Lock()
	defer m.buckets[bucketIndex].lock.Unlock()
	if value, ok := m.buckets[bucketIndex].values[key]; ok && value == oldValue {
		m.buckets[bucketIndex].values[key] = newValue
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func hash(key string) int {
	h := 0
	for _, b := range key {
		h = (h * 31 + int(b)) & 0x7fffffff
	}
	return h
}

struct ViewStampedReplication {
    nodes: HashMap<u32, Node>,
    leader: Option<u32>,
}

impl ViewStampedReplication {
    // Create a new viewStamped replication system
    fn new() -> Self {
        let mut nodes = HashMap::new();
        for i in 0..10 {
            nodes.insert(i, Node { id: i, votes: 1, view: 1 });
        }
        ViewStampedReplication { nodes, leader: None }
    }

    // Elect a leader for the system
    fn elect_leader(&mut self) {
        // Simulate voting process
        for node in self.nodes.values_mut() {
            node.votes = 1;
        }
        // Select the node with the most votes as the leader
        let mut max_votes = 0;
        let mut leader = None;
        for (node_id, node) in self.nodes.iter_mut() {
            if node.votes > max_votes {
                max_votes = node.votes;
                leader = Some(*node_id);
            }
        }
        self.leader = leader;
    }

    // Re-elect a leader for the system
    fn re_elect_leader(&mut self) {
        // Reset votes for all nodes
        for node in self.nodes.values_mut() {
            node.votes = 0;
        }
        // Elect a new leader
        self.elect_leader();
    }

    // Get the current leader of the system
    fn get_leader(&self) -> Option<u32> {
        self.leader.clone()
    }

import random
import time
from typing import Callable, List

class ExponentialBackoffStrategy:
    def __init__(self, initial_delay: float, max_delay: float, factor: float):
        self.initial_delay = initial_delay
        self.max_delay = max_delay
        self.factor = factor

    def calculate_delay(self, attempt: int) -> float:
        return min(self.initial_delay * (self.factor ** attempt), self.max_delay)

class JitterStrategy:
    def __init__(self, jitter_percentage: float):
        self.jitter_percentage = jitter_percentage

    def apply_jitter(self, delay: float) -> float:
        return delay * (1 + (random.random() * 2 * self.jitter_percentage / 100 - self.jitter_percentage / 100))

class CircuitBreaker:
    def __init__(self, threshold: int, timeout: float):
        self.threshold = threshold
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.attempts = 0
        self.last_reset = time.time()

    def is_open(self) -> bool:
        return self.attempts >= self.threshold

    def reset(self):
        self.attempts = 0
        self.last_reset = time.time()

class RetryStrategy:
    def __init__(self, max_attempts: int, backoff_strategy: ExponentialBackoffStrategy, jitter_strategy: JitterStrategy, circuit_breaker: CircuitBreaker):
        self.max_attempts = max_attempts
        self.backoff_strategy = backoff_strategy
        self.jitter_strategy = jitter_strategy
        self.circuit_breaker = circuit_breaker

    def retry(self, func: Callable, *args, **kwargs) -> any:
        attempt = 1
        while attempt <= self.max_attempts:
            try:
                return func(*args, **kwargs)
            except Exception as e:
                if self.circuit_breaker.is_open():
                    print(f"Circuit breaker open. Waiting for {self.circuit_breaker.timeout} seconds before retrying.")
                    time.sleep(self.circuit_breaker.timeout)
                else:
                    delay = self.backoff_strategy.calculate_delay(attempt)
                    delay = self.jitter_strategy.apply_jitter(delay)
                    print(f"Retry {attempt} in {delay} seconds...")
                    time.sleep(delay)
                    attempt += 1
        raise Exception("Maximum attempts exceeded.")

def example_function() -> None:
    # Simulate a failed operation
    raise Exception("Operation failed.")

def main() -> None:
    retry_strategy = RetryStrategy(
        max_attempts=5,
        backoff_strategy=ExponentialBackoffStrategy(1, 10, 2),
        jitter_strategy=JitterStrategy(10),
        circuit_breaker=CircuitBreaker(3, 5)
    )
    retry_strategy.retry(example_function)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

class Paxos:
    def __init__(self):
        self.proposal_id = 0
        self.accepted_value = None
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def propose(self, value):
        with self.lock:
            self.proposal_id += 1
            return self.propose_single(value)

        for node in nodes:

            accept_responses = []
            for node in nodes:
                accept_responses.append(node.accept(value, self.proposal_id))
            
            # Check if all nodes accept the value
            if all(response == 'ack' for response in accept_responses):
                # Update accepted value
                with self.lock:
                    self.accepted_value = value
                    return value

import typing
from typing import Dict, List, Optional

class TrieNode:
    def __init__(self):
        self.children: Dict[str, TrieNode] = {}
        self.is_word: bool = False
        self.word_freq: int = 0

class Trie:
    def __init__(self):
        self.root: TrieNode = TrieNode()

    def insert(self, word: str, freq: int) -> None:
        node: TrieNode = self.root
        for char in word:
            if char not in node.children:
                node.children[char] = TrieNode()
            node = node.children[char]
        node.is_word = True
        node.word_freq = freq

    def prefix_search(self, prefix: str, k: int) -> List[str]:
        node: TrieNode = self.root
        for char in prefix:
            if char not in node.children:
                return []
            node = node.children[char]
        return self._dfs(node, prefix, k)

    def fuzzy_match(self, word: str, k: int) -> List[str]:
        return self._fuzzy_match(self.root, word, k)

    def _fuzzy_match(self, node: TrieNode, word: str, k: int) -> List[str]:
        if node.is_word:
            return [word]
        if k == 0:
            return []
        best_matches: List[str] = []
        for char in node.children:
            match: str = self._fuzzy_match(node.children[char], word, k - 1)
            if match:
                best_matches.extend(match)
        return best_matches

    def _dfs(self, node: TrieNode, prefix: str, k: int) -> List[str]:
        if node.is_word:
            return [prefix]
        matches: List[str] = []
        for char in node.children:
            match: str = self._dfs(node.children[char], prefix + char, k)
            if match:
                matches.extend(match)
        return matches

    def update(self, word: str, freq: int) -> None:
        self.insert(word, freq)

    def get_freq(self, word: str) -> int:
        node: TrieNode = self.root
        for char in word:
            if char not in node.children:
                return 0
            node = node.children[char]
        return node.word_freq

package main

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
)

// KeyValueStore represents a simple key-value store.
type KeyValueStore struct {
	dataDir string
	wal     *wal
	snapshots map[string][]byte
	mu        sync.RWMutex
}

// NewKeyValueStore returns a new KeyValueStore instance.
func NewKeyValueStore(dataDir string) (*KeyValueStore, error) {
	wal, err := newWAL(filepath.Join(dataDir, "wal"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &KeyValueStore{
		dataDir: dataDir,
		wal:     wal,
		snapshots: map[string][]byte{},
	}, nil
}

// Get returns the value associated with the given key.
func (kvs *KeyValueStore) Get(key []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	kvs.mu.RLock()
	defer kvs.mu.RUnlock()
	return kvs.snapshots[string(key)]
}

// Set sets the value associated with the given key.
func (kvs *KeyValueStore) Set(key, value []byte) error {
	kvs.mu.Lock()
	defer kvs.mu.Unlock()
	kvs.snapshots[string(key)] = value
	return kvs.wal.Append(key, value)
}

// wal represents a Write-Ahead Log.
type wal struct {
	file *os.File
}

func newWAL(path string) (*wal, error) {
	f, err := os.Create(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &wal{file: f}, nil
}

func (w *wal) Append(key, value []byte) error {
	// Append the key-value pair to the WAL.
	w.file.Write(key)
	w.file.Write(value)
	// Create a snapshot of the current state.
	snap := make([]byte, len(w.file.Fd()))
	_, err := w.file.ReadAt(snap, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	// Save the snapshot.
	kvs.mu.Lock()
	defer kvs.mu.Unlock()
	kvs.snapshots[string(key)] = snap
	return nil
}

func (w *wal) Close() error {
	return w.file.Close()
}

      import { MurmurHash3 } from 'murmurhash3';
      import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

      export class HashRing {
        private ring: Map<string, string>;
        private virtualNodes: number;
        private replicas: number;

        constructor(virtualNodes: number, replicas: number) {
          this.ring = new Map();
          this.virtualNodes = virtualNodes;
          this.replicas = replicas;
        }

        public addNode(node: string): void {
          for (let i = 0; i < this.replicas; i++) {
            const hash = MurmurHash3.hash32(node + i.toString());
            const key = this.getKey(hash);
            this.ring.set(key, node);
          }
        }

        public removeNode(node: string): void {
          this.ring.forEach((value, key) => {
            if (value === node) {
              this.ring.delete(key);
            }
          });
        }

        public getNode(key: string): string | undefined {
          for (let i = 0; i < this.replicas; i++) {
            const hash = MurmurHash3.hash32(key + i.toString());
            const ringKey = this.getKey(hash);
            const node = this.ring.get(ringKey);
            if (node) {
              return node;
            }
          }
          return undefined;
        }

        private getKey(hash: number): string {
          return (hash % this.virtualNodes).toString();
        }
      }
    `

from decimal import Decimal, getcontext

def multiply_matrices(F, M):
    x = F[0, 0]*M[0, 0] + F[0, 1]*M[1, 0]
    y = F[0, 0]*M[0, 1] + F[0, 1]*M[1, 1]
    z = F[1, 0]*M[0, 0] + F[1, 1]*M[1, 0]
    w = F[1, 0]*M[0, 1] + F[1, 1]*M[1, 1]

    F[0, 0] = x
    F[0, 1] = y
    F[1, 0] = z
    F[1, 1] = w

def matrix_power(F, n):
    if n == 1:
        return F
    if n % 2 == 0:
        half_pow = matrix_power(F, n//2)
        return multiply_matrices(half_pow, half_pow)
    else:
        half_pow = matrix_power(F, n//2)
        return multiply_matrices(multiply_matrices(half_pow, half_pow), F)

    if n <= 1:
        return n
    F = matrix_power(F, n-1)
    return int(F[0, 0])

import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

public class RateLimiter {
    private final AtomicInteger requests;
    private final long limit;
    private final long period;

    public RateLimiter(long limit, long period) {
        this.requests = new AtomicInteger(0);
        this.limit = limit;
        this.period = period;
    }

    public boolean isRateLimited() {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000;
        long sinceLastReset = now - (now % period);

        long allowedRequests = limit * (now - sinceLastReset) / period;

        return requests.get() >= allowedRequests;
    }

    public void reset() {
        requests.set(0);
    }
  }

def base62_encode(counter: int) -> str:
    chars = '0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
    encoded = ''
    while counter > 0:
        encoded = chars[counter % 62] + encoded
        counter //= 62
    return encoded

    if URL.query.filter_by(alias=alias).first():
        return {'error': 'Alias already exists'}, 400
    counter = int.from_bytes(original_url.encode(), 'big')

    new_url = f'http://localhost:5000/{encoded_counter}'
    db.session.add(URL(original_url=original_url, alias=alias, expiry_date=expiry_date))
    db.session.commit()

class ASTNode:
    def __init__(self, type, children=None):

        self.children = children if children else []

class SelectStmt(ASTNode):
    def __init__(self, columns, table, where=None, join=None):
        super().__init__('SELECT')
        self.columns = columns
        self.table = table
        self.where = where
        self.join = join

class InsertStmt(ASTNode):
    def __init__(self, table, values):
        super().__init__('INSERT')
        self.table = table
        self.values = values

class UpdateStmt(ASTNode):
    def __init__(self, table, set_clause, where):
        super().__init__('UPDATE')
        self.table = table
        self.set_clause = set_clause
        self.where = where

class DeleteStmt(ASTNode):
    def __init__(self, table, where):
        super().__init__('DELETE')
        self.table = table
        self.where = where

class WhereClause(ASTNode):
    def __init__(self, condition):
        super().__init__('WHERE')
        self.condition = condition

class JoinClause(ASTNode):
    def __init__(self, type, table, on):
        super().__init__('JOIN')
        self.type = type
        self.table = table
        self.on = on

class GroupByClause(ASTNode):

class OrderByClause(ASTNode):

        self.columns = columns
        self.order = order

class LimitClause(ASTNode):

        self.value = value

    insert << (pp.one_of('INSERT') + pp.rest_of_line())
    update << (pp.one_of('UPDATE') + pp.rest_of_line())
    delete << (pp.one_of('DELETE') + pp.rest_of_line())
    where << (pp.one_of('WHERE') + pp.rest_of_line())
    join << (pp.one_of('INNER', 'LEFT') + pp.one_of('JOIN') + pp.rest_of_line())
    group_by << (pp.one_of('GROUP BY') + pp.rest_of_line())
    order_by << (pp.one_of('ORDER BY') + pp.rest_of_line())
    limit << (pp.one_of('LIMIT') + pp.rest_of_line())

    select_stmt = SelectStmt(
        select.parse_string(sql).as_list()[0],
        select.parse_string(sql).as_list()[1],
        where.parse_string(sql).as_list()[0] if where.parse_string(sql).as_list() else None,
        join.parse_string(sql).as_list()[0] if join.parse_string(sql).as_list() else None,

    elif condition.startswith('!='):

    elif condition.startswith('<'):

    elif condition.startswith('>'):

    elif isinstance(ast, InsertStmt):

import typing

class Graph:
    def __init__(self):
        self.nodes = {}

    def add_node(self, node: str):
        if node not in self.nodes:
            self.nodes[node] = set()

    def add_edge(self, node1: str, node2: str):
        if node1 in self.nodes and node2 in self.nodes:
            self.nodes[node1].add(node2)

    def has_cycle(self) -> bool:
        visited = set()
        recursion_stack = set()

        def dfs(node: str) -> bool:
            visited.add(node)
            recursion_stack.add(node)

            for neighbor in self.nodes.get(node, set()):
                if neighbor not in visited:
                    if dfs(neighbor):
                        return True
                elif neighbor in recursion_stack:
                    return True

            recursion_stack.remove(node)
            return False

        for node in self.nodes:
            if node not in visited:
                if dfs(node):
                    return True

        return False

    def topological_sort(self) -> list:
        if self.has_cycle():
            raise ValueError("Graph contains a cycle")

        sorted_nodes = []
        visited = set()

        def dfs(node: str) -> None:
            visited.add(node)
            for neighbor in self.nodes.get(node, set()):
                if neighbor not in visited:
                    dfs(neighbor)
            sorted_nodes.append(node)

        for node in self.nodes:
            if node not in visited:
                dfs(node)

        return sorted_nodes[::-1]

class TaskScheduler:
    def __init__(self):
        self.graph = Graph()

    def add_task(self, task: str):
        self.graph.add_node(task)

    def add_dependency(self, task: str, dependency: str):
        self.graph.add_edge(dependency, task)

    def schedule_tasks(self) -> list:
        return self.graph.topological_sort()

    def has_cycle(self) -> bool:
        return self.graph.has_cycle()

"""

package ratelimiter

import (
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// RateLimiter is a struct to store client data and a sliding window
type RateLimiter struct {
	clientData map[string]*ClientData
	mu         sync.RWMutex
}

// ClientData is a struct to store client data
type ClientData struct {
	requests  []time.Time
	window    time.Duration
	maxRequests int
}

// NewRateLimiter returns a new RateLimiter instance
func NewRateLimiter() *RateLimiter {
	return &RateLimiter{
		clientData: make(map[string]*ClientData),
	}
}

// AddRequest adds a request to the client's data
func (r *RateLimiter) AddRequest(clientID string, t time.Time) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	if cd, ok := r.clientData[clientID]; ok {

import os
import pickle
import threading

class WAL:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = path
        self.log = {}
        self.checkpoint = 0
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def log_record(self, lsn, record):
        with self.lock:
            self.log[lsn] = record
            self.checkpoint = max(self.checkpoint, lsn)

    def force_write(self, lsn):
        with self.lock:
            for i in range(self.checkpoint, lsn + 1):
                self.log_record(i, self.log[i])

    def checkpoint(self):
        with open(f"{self.path}.chk", "wb") as f:
            pickle.dump(self.checkpoint, f)

    def recover(self):
        if os.path.exists(f"{self.path}.chk"):
            with open(f"{self.path}.chk", "rb") as f:
                self.checkpoint = pickle.load(f)
        return self.checkpoint


class Transaction:
    def __init__(self, wal, lsn):
        self.wal = wal
        self.lsn = lsn

    def commit(self):
        self.wal.force_write(self.lsn)

    def checkpoint(self):
        self.wal.checkpoint()

	"net"

	"github.com/bmizerany/patricia"
	"github.com/hashicorp/go-hclog"

type LoadBalancer struct {
	ring  *patricia.Ring
	servers map[string]*Server
	mu      sync.Mutex
}

type Server struct {
	Host string
	Port int
}

func (lb *LoadBalancer) AddServer(host string, port int) {
	lb.mu.Lock()
	defer lb.mu.Unlock()

	lb.servers[fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", host, port)] = &Server{
		Host: host,
		Port: port,
	}
}

func (lb *LoadBalancer) GetServer(ctx context.Context) (*Server, error) {
	lb.mu.Lock()
	defer lb.mu.Unlock()

	hash := lb.ring.GetHash(ctx)
	servers := lb.ring.GetServers(hash)

	if len(servers) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no servers available")
	}

	// Select a server with some randomness to avoid hotspots
	rand.Seed(time.Now().UnixNano())
	idx := rand.Intn(len(servers))
	return servers[idx], nil
}

func (lb *LoadBalancer) Start() {
	lb.ring = patricia.NewRing()
	lb.servers = make(map[string]*Server)

	// Add some servers to the ring
	lb.AddServer("server1", 8080)
	lb.AddServer("server2", 8080)
	lb.AddServer("server3", 8080)

	// Start the load balancer
	go func() {
		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Second)
		for range ticker.C {
			lb.ring.Update()
		}
	}()
}

func main() {
	lb := &LoadBalancer{}
	lb.Start()

	// Create a server to test the load balancer
	l, err := net.Listen("tcp", ":8080")
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)

	for {
		conn, err := l.Accept()
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)

			s, err := lb.GetServer(context.Background())
			if err != nil {

			}
			// Forward the request to the selected server
			fmt.Fprintf(conn, "Forwarding request to %s:%d", s.Host, s.Port)
		}()
	}
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"math/rand"
	"time"
)

func Retry(ctx context.Context, fn func() error) error {
	var (
		lastErr error
		attempts int
	)
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return fmt.Errorf("context cancelled: %w", ctx.Err())
		default:
			err := fn()
			if err == nil {
				return nil
			}
			lastErr = err
			attempts++

			// Exponential backoff with jitter
			jitter := time.Duration(rand.Int63n(int64(attempts * 2 + 1))) * time.Millisecond
			backoff := time.Duration(attempts * 2 + 1) * time.Second
			time.Sleep(backoff + jitter)
		}
	}
}

import re
import time
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

class RegexEngine:
    def __init__(self, pattern: str):
        self.pattern = pattern
        self.nfa: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
        self.stack: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []

    def build_nfa(self):
        self.nfa['start'] = {'epsilon': 'start'}
        self.stack.append(('start', ''))

        for char in self.pattern:
            if char == '.':
                self.add_transition('start', 'dot', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append(('dot', ''))
            elif char == '*':
                self.add_transition('start', 'star', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append(('star', ''))
            elif char == '+':
                self.add_transition('start', 'plus', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append(('plus', ''))
            elif char == '?':
                self.add_transition('start', 'question', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append(('question', ''))
            elif char == '[':
                self.add_transition('start', 'char_class', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append(('char_class', ''))
            elif char == '(':
                self.add_transition('start', 'group', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append(('group', ''))
            elif char == ')':
                self.add_transition('start', 'end_group', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append(('end_group', ''))
            elif char == '^':
                self.add_transition('start', 'anchor', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append(('anchor', ''))
            elif char == '$':
                self.add_transition('start', 'anchor', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append(('anchor', ''))
            elif char == '\\':
                self.add_transition('start', 'escape', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append(('escape', ''))
            else:
                self.add_transition('start', char, 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append((char, ''))

        while self.stack:
            state, char = self.stack.pop()
            if char == '':
                continue
            if char == 'dot':
                self.add_transition(state, 'dot', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append((state, ''))
            elif char == 'star':
                self.add_transition(state, 'star', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append((state, ''))
            elif char == 'plus':
                self.add_transition(state, 'plus', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append((state, ''))
            elif char == 'question':
                self.add_transition(state, 'question', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append((state, ''))
            elif char == 'char_class':
                self.add_transition(state, 'char_class', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append((state, ''))
            elif char == 'group':
                self.add_transition(state, 'group', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append((state, ''))
            elif char == 'end_group':
                self.add_transition(state, 'end_group', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append((state, ''))
            elif char == 'anchor':
                self.add_transition(state, 'anchor', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append((state, ''))
            elif char == 'escape':
                self.add_transition(state, 'escape', 'epsilon')
                self.stack.append((state, ''))
            else:
                self.add_transition(state, char, 'epsilon')

    def add_transition(self, from_state: str, to_state: str, label: str):
        if from_state not in self.nfa:
            self.nfa[from_state] = {}
        self.nfa[from_state][label] = to_state

    def match(self, string: str):
        current_state = 'start'
        for char in string:
            if char in self.nfa[current_state]:
                current_state = self.nfa[current_state][char]
            elif char == '.' and '.' in self.nfa[current_state]:
                current_state = self.nfa[current_state]['.']
            elif char == '*' and '*' in self.nfa[current_state]:
                current_state = self.nfa[current_state]['*']
            elif char == '+' and '+' in self.nfa[current_state]:
                current_state = self.nfa[current_state]['+']
            elif char == '?' and '?' in self.nfa[current_state]:
                current_state = self.nfa[current_state]['?']
            elif char == '[' and '[' in self.nfa[current_state]:
                current_state = self.nfa[current_state]['[']
            elif char == '(' and '(' in self.nfa[current_state]:
                current_state = self.nfa[current_state]['(']
            elif char == ')' and ')' in self.nfa[current_state]:
                current_state = self.nfa[current_state][')']
            elif char == '^' and '^' in self.nfa[current_state]:
                current_state = self.nfa[current_state]['^']
            elif char == '$' and '$' in self.nfa[current_state]:
                current_state = self.nfa[current_state]['$']
            elif char == '\\' and '\\' in self.nfa[current_state]:
                current_state = self.nfa[current_state]['\\']
            else:
                return False
        return current_state == 'accept'

def main():
    pattern = 'a.b*a+b?'
    regex_engine = RegexEngine(pattern)
    regex_engine.build_nfa()
    string = 'abcabcab'
    start_time = time.time()
    for _ in range(10000):
        regex_engine.match(string)
    end_time = time.time()
    print(f'Time taken by regex engine: {end_time - start_time} seconds')

    re_pattern = re.compile(pattern)
    start_time = time.time()
    for _ in range(10000):
        re_pattern.fullmatch(string)
    end_time = time.time()
    print(f'Time taken by re module: {end_time - start_time} seconds')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import random

class PersistentStateStore:
    def __init__(self, node_id):
        self.node_id = node_id
        self.state = self.load_state()

    def load_state(self):
        try:
            with open(f'state_{self.node_id}.json', 'r') as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return {
                'term': 0,
                'vote': None,
                'commit_index': 0,
                'log': [],
                'last_applied': 0
            }

    def save_state(self):
        with open(f'state_{self.node_id}.json', 'w') as f:
            json.dump(self.state, f)

class Node:
    def __init__(self, node_id, persistent_state_store):
        self.node_id = node_id
        self.persistent_state_store = persistent_state_store
        self.current_term = self.persistent_state_store.load_state()['term']
        self.voted_for = self.persistent_state_store.load_state()['vote']
        self.commit_index = self.persistent_state_store.load_state()['commit_index']
        self.log = self.persistent_state_store.load_state()['log']
        self.last_applied = self.persistent_state_store.load_state()['last_applied']
        self.state = 'follower'
        self.election_timeout = random.randint(500, 1500)  # 0.5-1.5 seconds
        self.start_time = time.time()

    def request_vote(self, candidate_id, candidate_term):
        if candidate_term > self.current_term:
            self.current_term = candidate_term
            self.voted_for = candidate_id
            self.persistent_state_store.save_state()
            return True
        return False

    def append_entries(self, leader_id, leader_term, entries):
        if leader_term > self.current_term:
            self.current_term = leader_term
            self.log.extend(entries)
            self.persistent_state_store.save_state()
            return True
        return False

    def step(self):
        if self.state == 'follower':
            if time.time() - self.start_time >= self.election_timeout / 1000:
                self.start_time = time.time()
                self.election_timeout = random.randint(500, 1500)  # 0.5-1.5 seconds
                self.persistent_state_store.save_state()
                self.request_vote(self.node_id, self.current_term + 1)
        elif self.state == 'candidate':
            self.persistent_state_store.save_state()
            self.state = 'follower'
        elif self.state == 'leader':
            self.step_as_leader()

    def step_as_leader(self):
        # Simulate log replication with consistency checks
        if self.commit_index < len(self.log):
            self.persistent_state_store.save_state()
            self.commit_index = len(self.log)
        # Simulate cluster membership changes
        if random.random() < 0.1:  # 10% chance of a node leaving the cluster
            self.persistent_state_store.save_state()
            self.log.pop(0)
            self.commit_index = len(self.log)

    def simulate_network_delay(self, delay):
        time.sleep(delay)

    def run(self):
        while True:
            self.step()
            self.simulate_network_delay(0.01)  # Simulate network delay
            print(f'Node {self.node_id} state: {self.state}')

    persistent_state_stores = [PersistentStateStore(node_id) for node_id in node_id]
    nodes = [Node(node_id, persistent_state_store) for node_id, persistent_state_store in zip(node_ids, persistent_state_stores)]

    for node in nodes:
        node.run()

    main()

import os
